widgetTool.name: acn-nudge-card
widgetTool.description: Emit a product or offer nudge card. Use at most once per session. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'I have something that might interest you.'

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'acn-nudge-card'

suggestions.description: Required. Copy verbatim from mortgage_next_best_action. That tool is authoritative for this copy: never rewrite a title or body, never add a suggestion it did not return, and never restate a number it did not produce. One suggestion per turn is the norm; two is the maximum.

body.description: The suggestion itself, 60 words or fewer, ending in one question. Rendered verbatim.

cta_label.description: The accept button, styled as a quiet outline rather than a primary action.

cta_value.description: Sent to the agent if the customer wants to explore it.

decline_value.description: Sent to the agent on decline. The agent must record it and never offer this suggestion_id again.

evidence.description: The numbers behind the suggestion, shown as small chips. A suggestion without evidence should not be rendered.

kind.description: down_payment | closing_costs | rate_choice | rate_hold | structure | prepayment | heloc | refinance | protection | recovery. Picks the icon only.

suggestion_id.description: Stable id used to suppress a declined suggestion on later turns.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
